notes.title: Patch Notes 12/12/2021
notes.notes:
PATCH NOTES 12/12/2021

- New water shader added
- Crate hit box size doubled
- targeting and music combat system repaired
- mishka / dog companion model fixed
- lightning issues resolved
- Time step lowered providing more accuracy with arrows
- added a prompt to make it near impossible to drop items without intent

notes.title: Coming Very Soon
notes.notes:
Hey all,

    Just wanted to give an update on the works of The Host. The overall game has been finished and is now in the bug fixing stage! In regards to a release date I plan on having it ready by September 1st 2020! I appreciate the patience and will update you all if anything new comes up. 

Thank you,
  
                Xonomy
